name: deepseek-harness-bridge
description: Control an existing DeepSeek Harness Web session from Codex through MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate Codex tasks to a visible local DSH session.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to an already running DeepSeek Harness Web process on loopback. Codex can create, continue, inspect, wait for, and cancel visible DSH sessions, apply configurable per-session permission presets, and surface exact approval requests without automatic approval.
defaultPrompt: Ask DeepSeek Harness to inspect this task and report back.
List the active DeepSeek Harness sessions.
Continue a DeepSeek Harness session and wait for its result.
Start a read-only DeepSeek Harness task and report any approval request without approving it.
